items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I always did admire the Clarnie players. Clarnie was always... I'd sit under them all the time.

ctx.x: That's alright. Tell us about when you started to take up music. What did you start on?
Well, I always did admire the Clarnie players. Clarnie was always... I'd sit under them all the time.
And I started taking up clarinet.
